nav-p-about-1: BAUN AISC – Artificial Intelligence & Security Research Group is a research group established on a voluntary basis within the Department of Computer Engineering at Balıkesir University in January 2026.
nav-p-about-2: The group aims to enhance students' academic research skills in the fields of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, explore current scientific studies, develop innovative projects, and produce high-quality academic outputs. Our goal is to transform the analytical power offered by artificial intelligence into an active force across every layer of cyber defense. In the evolving digital ecosystem, security is no longer merely about blocking threats; it is about anticipating future risks.
nav-p-about-3: We aim to be a dynamic community that embraces not only individual success but also knowledge sharing and a culture of continuous learning. By strengthening our members' industry and academic networks, we provide a seamless environment for mentorship and collaboration, enabling them to undertake projects that make a significant impact on the international stage. To this end, we strive to build an ecosystem that generates global value by bridging theoretical knowledge with practical application, and to cultivate leading researchers who will shape the digital world of the future. By building interdisciplinary bridges, we closely monitor the latest developments in the technology sector and collaborate to create a secure and sustainable future.
